title: In the skies
description: it adds sky related things like clouds and gliders
body:
For this mod i'm going to add a bunch of sky related things, so far while i'm currenty writing this i have made: a glider, a propeller, a flyable glider, and clouds. Eventually i will and more things and i will continue to update the description. Also I am aware of the bug where the screen will shake when using the flyable glider and I will try to fix it soon.

This mod was made in MCreator.
